scope: Bound host session completion and advisory Dream history
rationale: Issues #92, #100 and #101 connect session termination, meaningful Dream opportunities and truthful completion history. Frozen Python fixtures remain unchanged.
additions: Native SessionEnd/SessionStart handlers in generated Codex and Claude-compatible bundles
Explicit stopped-host recover-session command for one exact binding
Private termination intent journal and replay acknowledgement
corrections: Identity-free legacy session-end reports handled=false and no memory completion
Inactive sessions cannot be rebound for capture
Advisory decay failure rolls back scores and completes persisted work with an audited warning
Failure history retains the committed provider prefix and never marks completed persistence phases failed
Passive decay leaves the edit timestamp unchanged so overlapping independent sessions can each count
invariants: Resume cancels pending termination only after verifying an active bound session
Missing or foreign bindings do not complete unrelated sessions
Capture and conditional completion serialize in SQLite
No factual-confidence or active-rule changes through passive decay
qualification: Disposable CLI/daemon tests validate the implementation, not native installed-host acceptance
